prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one photorealistically accurate, exceptionally polished DESKTOP WEBSITE SECTION mockup for 8x Social, wide 1920x1080 composition. This is the existing second section “Creator content. Built for the feed.” being refined ONLY in its consistent video presentation. It must feel like a continuous carbon page, not a separate panel, not a dashboard.
Input references: images 1,2,3 are the exact three existing ORIGINAL creator video poster frames. Insert these actual frames in order, maintaining their entire 480x854 portrait content, faces and source text. Do not replace these people with generated models or hero portraits. Do not invent new videos.
Canvas background flat deep carbon #111111 edge-to-edge. At the top a quiet existing header: original serif-style “8x” then sans “social” left; small links “The network”, “How it works”, “For creators”, restrained orange “Let’s talk ↗” on right. No header line, no section line. Plenty of deliberate negative space.
Composition: left editorial text column about 30% width beginning near x80,y300. Exact large cream heading on two lines “Creator content.” / “Built for the feed.” with modern Inter-like typography, bold and beautifully kerned. Under it modest two-line copy exactly “Creators publish in their own voice.” / “We run the operation behind it.” Below that three subtle stacked text selectors “Entertainment”, “Everyday routines”, “Tech in the wild”. Small orange dot at Entertainment, tiny grey dots for the others. No card behind text.
Right media area starting around x750,y230: THREE IDENTICAL PORTRAIT VIDEO PLAYERS side by side aligned perfectly to the same top and bottom, with equal 22px gutters. Each around 300px wide and 534px image height, all original uncropped 9:16 footage. Shared precise edge system: a very fine 1px warm-grey keyline (#ffffff22), nearly square 4px radius, no thick border, no glows, no shadows, no hardware phone frame, no dotted rectangle around an individual video. All image content stays full colour and equally clear. The tiny tasteful brand dot belongs in each caption row, not a pattern laid over footage.
Directly BELOW every video frame, an IDENTICAL slim dark control strip about 36px tall, same carbon page tone, with small pause/play glyph at left, tiny hairline seek track, discreet speaker icon at right. First is playing, other two show play. A small orange trace only on active seek track; inactive tracks grey. Keep controls subtle, legible and consistent, without bottom cropping footage. Below each control strip a neat muted caption row exactly “@nickmakesmusic · TikTok”, “@mindful_witmee · TikTok”, “@techwithchow · Instagram”, with a miniature external arrow at far right. No platform badges. One small orange activity dot for the first player, grey for others.
At physical SCREEN edges only, very soft barely visible fine halftone atmosphere that fades completely inward; never turns into a card border. Far-right minimal approved scroll thread: single grey hairline 400px tall, 36px orange segment with tiny light center dot handle roughly one-quarter down. No native scrollbar.
Design objective: unify ALL video frames with one quietly confident visual grammar to reuse in later sections. Strong typographic scale, meaningful content, original candid real footage, extremely minimal Silicon Valley brand site. Nothing floats or tilts, no staggered cards, no rows or horizontal section dividers, no progress ornament under entire gallery, no repeated hero collage, no new metrics or headlines. Show finished website only, no explanatory board labels, annotations, palette chips or browser chrome. Render sharp, high quality.
